          • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace.           • Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety.           • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.

    Safety and Security
    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
    • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

      • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
      • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

Built for drivers who want SUV practicality with muscle-inspired performance, this Durango offers confident all-weather capability, premium comfort, and strong towing utility for life around Buffalo, Monticello, St. Michael, Albertville, and the greater Twin Cities area.
Powered by Dodge’s legendary 5.7L HEMI V8 and equipped with All-Wheel Drive, this Durango R/T delivers strong acceleration, confident handling, and the capability needed for Minnesota driving conditions. The Trailer Tow Group and Class IV receiver hitch add useful towing strength for trailers, boats, and weekend gear.
Inside, the six-passenger cabin is loaded with comfort features, including leather-trimmed upholstery, heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row seats, a heated steering wheel, memory settings, power front seats, second-row bucket seats, tri-zone automatic climate control, remote start, a power sunroof, power liftgate, universal garage door opener, 120-volt power outlet, and rear window defroster.
Technology highlights include navigation, an 8.4-inch touchscreen display, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, Bluetooth capability, and intuitive Uconnect controls. Safety and driver-assistance features include Adaptive Cruise Control, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Departure Warning, Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Cross Traffic Detection, Front and Rear Park Assist with automatic braking, a Rear Vision Camera, automatic high beams, HID headlamps, fog lamps, and keyless entry with push-button start.
The Blacktop Package gives this Durango a bold, aggressive look with deep-tinted glass and 20-inch gloss black aluminum wheels. Our reconditioning process included a multi-point inspection with oil change, a new engine air filter, and a complete interior and exterior detail. A free CARFAX Vehicle History Report is available on our website for added peace of mind.
If you’re searching for a used Dodge Durango R/T for sale in Buffalo, MN, this 2018 Durango delivers V8 power, premium comfort, advanced safety, and family-friendly versatility.
Contact us for availability and a test drive today. Buy with confidence at Ryan Auto Mall, where trust is earned and results speak for themselves. Backed by more than 23,000 customer reviews and 70 Minnesota DealerRater “Dealer of the Year” awards, we’ve built a reputation you can rely on. This vehicle is being sold as-is with no warranty. For added peace of mind, extended vehicle service contracts are available for purchase. Pricing includes all dealer fees. Government fees, including state sales tax, title, and licensing, are additional. Visit us at 1000 E Hwy 55 in Buffalo or call (763) 373-9300 to schedule your test drive and discover the Ryan difference.

    Convenience
    • Distance pacing cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. Distance pacing cruise control, your ultimate co-pilot.
    Safety and Security
    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
    • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
